bush_craft_keeper.text: Have a look around. Everything here is made within ten miles, and the odd thing within ten feet.
Please do not take stones from the Giant's Causeway. It is protected, and the columns miss every single one.
We have postcards and tea towels with giants on them. It is the closest you will get to a giant today.

then.text: Whatever Maeve decides, the kettle is still on. I am only the woman with the spare room and a very good cake tin.
Tell her I will keep the hatch warm, and the chair is better than the one she has.

else.text: Joanne Hill. I have the craft shop across the green, and I have a spare room that does nothing but hold tea towels.

I could host the counter in it: a hatch, a chair, Tuesday to Saturday ten till three. People would queue past the tea towels, and I am not stupid, I know that is good for me. It is also the only way I can afford to take it on.
No Mondays and no evenings. I cannot do more than five days and still be a craft shop. Someone will lose out, and I would like to know it will not be me alone.
Just looking at the premises. The light in here is lovely and the radiator is a crime.

w55n_hatch.text: The hatch is a window I cut myself. There is a queue past the tea towels, and the tea towels have never sold so well.
No Mondays. I have put a sign up. A lot of people have put 'Tuesday' on their calendar, and I have a very small, very guilty smile.
